BL-1573 — The dispatch-gap sweep's note fallback is not a dispatch trail: when head-commit-10 fails, auto-route! sends 'BL-x is active with no dispatch on record - auto-routed by the sweep.' and BL-1223's narrowed predicate reads that bare-id note as a mention, so the next sweep re-detects the gap and sends it again every cycle - the sibling unassigned-active nudge was made verb-first for exactly this in BL-1223; the dispatch-gap fallback was not
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored and a choice is posed. FIRM: whichever option is chosen, `unassigned-active-note-message` (already verb-first since BL-1223) and the git_handoff form `auto-route!` sends when HEAD resolves are untouched; `dispatch-trail-ticket-id` and `spec-work-ticket-id-pattern` are…
